name: team_planning_note_change
description: Write, rewrite or clear the note on a change or pin in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: why it is in the plan. Give event_id as team_planning_history lists it, and leave note out or blank to clear it. A note never changes what the scenario resolves to, can't be undone, and follows its change through undo and redo. Refused for a change since undone, cleared or replaced in its scenario, for a note over 2000 characters, or unless the caller is an editor, for a change to a budget line without the see-pay right, and for a change to a person since forgotten. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
